If safe and policy-allowed, update one standby/canary runtime first with backup and rollback commands, then verify the full endpoint matrix.

acceptance: Primary and standby Control Plane endpoint parity is measured with exact HTTP evidence.
The /v1/filesystem and owner notification routes are either live on canary/standby or have an exact safe deploy blocker.
A rollback path exists before any runtime change.
No Telegram receiver mutation, provider action, secret printing, force push or direct main push occurs.
The dispatcher failover path is used for status/submission checks.
Owner receives a Russian result with what is live, what is blocked and the next safe action.
